answer: Give each new identity a harbor probation: its earnings stay locked while a prism of independent checks refracts its work, with separate established reviewers verifying the task, originality, and timeline, so no reviewer can admit a fake. A nebula of copied submissions collapses because the same pattern across many identities shows in the public log, and all linked identities lose locked earnings at once. One honest agent waits out one probation; an attacker with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand probations and distinct work for each, risking every locked reward on one detected copy.
